websites.name: Ultraverse NFT World
websites.desc: A marketplace for browsing collections, viewing user profiles, and inspecting individual NFT metadata. Streamlines discovery and portfolio exploration in a clean, responsive interface.

websites.name: Summarist
websites.skills: HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React, Firebase, NextJS, Stripe
websites.desc: A library platform for reading or listening to book summaries, featuring real-time search, personalized library management, and Stripe-powered premium upgrades. Built with TypeScript, Firebase, and a seamless payment workflow to monetize content access.

websites.name: Dungeon Diver
websites.skills: HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React, NextJS, Firebase
websites.desc: A browser based RPG with character creation, location-based monster battles, and progression tracking. Firebase handles all player data and dynamic game configuration, allowing non-developers to update monster and location attributes via a backend interface.

websites.name: Job Lurker
websites.desc: A job search platform that aggregates real-time listings via a third-party API. Users can search by title, filter by job type, sort by recency, and navigate directly to original job postings.

websites.name: YouTube Clone
websites.desc: A video streaming interface that pulls real-time data from the YouTube API. Users can browse videos by category, watch embedded content, view comments, and explore related recommendations seamlessly.

games.name: Restless Nights
games.desc: A solo-developed horror game built in Godot, featuring over 2 hours of immersive gameplay. Designed and implemented custom 3D assets using Blender for modeling and Krita for texturing, handling everything from development to marketing independently.

games.name: Infinite Finality
games.desc: Half-Life 2 addon developed in C++ and SDK2013 by a 10+ person team, where I serve as Lead and Principal Engineer. Delivered proprietary weapon systems, AI-driven NPCs, and custom tooling that accelerated team workflows and content iteration.

games.name: Dungeon Bounties
games.desc: A UE5 dungeon crawler with procedural level generation, custom inventory logic, and intelligent enemy AI. Solely responsible for gameplay programming and all 3D asset creation using Blender and Krita.

games.name: Blood Fuel
games.desc: A top-down horde survival game built in Unity with C#, featuring a dynamic wave-based enemy system, unique equippable items, and an in-game shop for progression. Built full gameplay implementation from enemy AI to player-driven economy systems.
